headline: ModelingRules reverted across 88 packs, undoing yesterday's identity.* migration; new BechtleDarkWebScan pack
summary_md:
- The day is one upstream revert and little else: **ModelingRules changes across 88 packs** (#45814), taking back the `identity.*` modeling-rule migration that landed the day before.
- 82 of the 91 packs that moved carry that revert's shape — 5 lines added against 36 to 1,251 removed, roughly 13,800 deletions between them.
- **BechtleDarkWebScan** arrives as a new pack, 2,537 lines with nothing removed.
- **GCP** takes a Google Cloud Storage migration (CRTX-215182), the largest change to an existing pack at +2,369/-159.
- The day is net negative overall: 6,498 insertions against 15,546 deletions across 91 packs.

highlights.title: The identity.* modeling-rule migration is reverted across 88 packs
highlights.detail: 73 of the 82 revert-shaped packs are ones that moved in yesterday's migration, and for 70 of them today's deletion count is exactly seven lines short of yesterday's insertion count — the same rules, taken back out.

highlights.title: New pack: BechtleDarkWebScan
highlights.detail: Added whole at 2,537 insertions and no deletions (#45810), the only new data source on the board today.

highlights.title: GCP pack takes a Google Cloud Storage migration
highlights.detail: CRTX-215182 (#45501) replaces 159 lines with 2,369, making it the largest change to a pack that already existed.

highlights.title: Doppel integration reaches pack v1.2.0
highlights.detail: #45809 adds reopening of revived alerts, filters on get-alerts, and client attribution, for +146/-3.

highlights.title: ServiceNow and FireEyeHX churn without a commit naming them
highlights.detail: ServiceNow loses a net 564 lines (+253/-817) and FireEyeHX is rewritten roughly in place (+464/-453); none of the day's four commit subjects mentions either pack.
